definition.zh-TW:
研究發展費用占營業收入的比例，也就是公司每做一元生意，花多少錢在研發上。

比例高低主要反映產業特性與公司策略，跨產業直接比較意義不大；和同業比，才看得出誰在研發上投入得比較積極。
definition.en:
Research and development expenses as a share of revenue: how much the company spends on research for each unit of sales.

The level mostly reflects the industry and the company’s strategy, so comparing across industries says little; set it against peers to see who invests more heavily in research.

example.zh-TW: 兩個數字都在損益表上。本課故事沒有研發費用，所以比率是 0。別名是研發密度。
example.en: Both figures are on the income statement. The course story has no research expense, so the ratio is zero. It is also called research intensity.

misconception.zh-TW: 把 RD intensity 當成研發的成效。它只衡量投入多少，不衡量產出；研發花得多不代表做出好產品。要看成效得另外看營收成長或新產品占比。
misconception.en: Reading R&D intensity as research effectiveness. It measures input, not output; spending heavily does not guarantee good products. To judge results, look at revenue growth or the share of sales from new products.

formula.zh-TW: RD intensity ＝ 研究發展費用 ÷ 營業收入。
formula.en: R&D intensity = research and development expenses ÷ revenue.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是國際通用的說法；網站依課程的公式計算。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios; the name follows international usage, and the site calculates it with the course formula.
